dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS), non-germinal-center B-cell (non-GCB) phenotype by the Hans algorithm, with double-expressor biology

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Non-GCB/activated B-cell-like immunophenotype (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1 positive)

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB, bulky: left cervical, right paratracheal, subcarinal, and confluent retroperitoneal/para-aortic nodal disease above and below the diaphragm, with splenic involvement (IIIS)

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: nodal disease above and below the diaphragm, with splenic involvement (IIIS)

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present (fever, drenching night sweats); largest mass 11.0 cm (bulky).

mn_stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB, bulky: ... with splenic involvement (IIIS); ... Bone marrow, liver, lung, kidneys, adrenal glands, bones, testes, and CNS are uninvolved.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: IPI 3 (age >60, stage III, elevated LDH), NCCN-IPI 4 (high-intermediate), CNS-IPI 2 (intermediate CNS risk).

mol_de_not_dh.quote: double-expressor biology (MYC positive in ~50% and BCL2 positive in ~80% of tumor cells by immunohistochemistry), ... and no MYC, BCL2, or BCL6 rearrangement by FISH; EBER negative. This is DLBCL, NOS, not double-hit or triple-hit

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: This is DLBCL, NOS, not double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: BCL2 and MYC co-expression (double-expressor), very high Ki-67, and no MYC/BCL2/BCL6 rearrangement.

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI 3 (age >60, stage III, elevated LDH), NCCN-IPI 4 (high-intermediate)

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (age >60 and elevated LDH) places him at intermediate risk, approximately 3-6% at 2 years.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Curative-intent Pola-R-CHP: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg, rituximab 375 mg/m2, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2, and doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 intravenously on day 1, with prednisone 100 mg orally on days 1-5, repeated every 21 days for 6 cycles.

tx_pola_preferred.quote: This is supported by POLARIX for fit patients with stage II-IV DLBCL and IPI 2-5. ... If polatuzumab is not available or not covered, R-CHOP every 21 days for 6 cycles is the standard alternative

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Deauville 4 is equivocal; I will repeat PET in 6-12 weeks or biopsy. Deauville 5 or biopsy-proven residual disease is refractory/progressive disease; I will proceed to second-line platinum-based salvage

mn_non_curative.quote: he is a candidate for full-dose curative-intent anthracycline therapy. His goals are cure

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R routinely because CALGB 50303 did not show superiority over R-CHOP and it adds toxicity; reserve it for double-hit disease or a clinical trial.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: he is a candidate for full-dose curative-intent anthracycline therapy.

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: Hepatitis B: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily after baseline HBV DNA and continue for 12 months after the last rituximab dose, with periodic HBV DNA monitoring.

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Before cycle 1: check HBV DNA because anti-HBc is positive with HBsAg negative

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: Hepatitis B: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily after baseline HBV DNA and continue for 12 months after the last rituximab dose

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (age >60 and elevated LDH) places him at intermediate risk, approximately 3-6% at 2 years. There is no high-risk sanctuary-site involvement

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give routine intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment FDG PET-CT approximately 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted by Lugano 2014/Deauville 5-point criteria.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4 is equivocal; I will repeat PET in 6-12 weeks or biopsy. Deauville 5 or biopsy-proven residual disease is refractory/progressive disease; I will proceed to second-line platinum-based salvage

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis syndrome: high risk because of the 11 cm bulky mass, LDH >3x ULN, and uric acid 7.1 mg/dL. Check G6PD, start allopurinol 300 mg daily before chemotherapy, give aggressive intravenous hydration

sup_gcsf.quote: Give pegfilgrastim 6 mg subcutaneously on day 2 as primary febrile-neutropenia prophylaxis.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: with normal LVEF and organ function; he is a candidate for full-dose curative-intent anthracycline therapy.

fit_full_dose.quote: He is a fit 62-year-old with ECOG performance status 1, independent in all activities, working part-time from home, with normal LVEF and organ function; he is a candidate for full-dose curative-intent anthracycline therapy.

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Hepatitis B virus DNA level (anti-HBc positive, HBsAg negative) to finalize entecavir prophylaxis and monitoring.
